objective: Define the narrow first execution boundary that may turn reviewed process-to-launcher CLI fixture metadata into a future src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py launcher process start, without executing that launcher, sidecar stages, compare, or timing in this gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted fixture proves only that a Verilator-facing process payload can be bound to exact run_hybrid_template.py argv. A future run may still fail while starting the launcher, inside sidecar build/run stages, or during coverage-output compare, so launcher argv materialization remains metadata until a reviewed run gate executes it.
reason: the previous review accepted define_process_to_launcher_cli_fixture only as non-executing metadata
the predecessor structured launcher invocation run review remains reference evidence but not current execution authority
the next useful step is defining exactly when a future process may start the existing launcher from reviewed fixture metadata
coverage_output_equivalence remains the scoped correctness policy only after a later reviewed run reaches compare

artifacts: raw state dumps used by compare

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser, process-to-launcher metadata, or sidecar context is missing target/template/shape/source context
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: reviewed source closure or template authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_cli_bridge_failure: the reviewed process payload cannot be converted into the exact structured launcher CLI argv
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the future run attempts to start the existing launcher from structured argv but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_process_to_launcher_cli_execution_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the future execution boundary is narrow enough for a first process-to-launcher CLI run attempt from reviewed fixture metadata
whether exact launcher argv, sidecar context, source authority, structured invocation reference, and compare policy stay separate
whether materialized argv remains metadata until a later run starts the launcher
whether launcher invocation, sidecar stage, compare, and timing failure classes remain distinguishable
whether generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain out of scope
must_not_claim: process-to-launcher CLI runtime execution by this definition gate

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
